datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B Surface Mount Silicon Zener Diodes

extraction_notes: The supplied PDF SHA-256 matches the expected digest fec00843f279bccf78d55a456b749bf49d99676181d710880c28c93d8ee35181.
The MMSZ5250B row specifies nominal VZ = 20.0 V, IZT = 6.2 mA, maximum ZZT = 25 ohm, maximum IR = 0.1 uA at VR = 15 V, all at TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
The zener curve points are manual digitizations of the real curve labelled 20 in Fig. 2; no interpolated or synthesized points were added.
The capacitance value is a manual digitization of the real 0V-bias typical curve in Fig. 5 at nominal VZ = 20 V, with VR = 0 V and f = 1 MHz.
Reverse recovery is omitted because the datasheet publishes no trr or switching-time specification.
Zener knee sharpness is not extractable from the supplied table because ZZK at IZK is not published; only maximum ZZT at IZT is provided.
